question: After free-form reason text is removed from durable storage, should OpenClaw adopt the 512-row metadata-only restart ledger as the canonical local restart record?
rationale: The privacy defect has a narrow mechanical repair, but accepting a new permanent shared-state audit and retention contract requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt closed-code ledger
options.body: Persist only stable reason and source codes with fixed retention and approve the table as the canonical restart record.

options.title: Narrow the ledger further
options.body: Reduce the stored field set or producer coverage before accepting the durable contract.

options.title: Keep restart audit transient
options.body: Decline persistent state and use structured logs or diagnostics for restart attribution.

recommendation.title: Adopt closed-code ledger
recommendation.body: Persist only stable reason and source codes with fixed retention and approve the table as the canonical restart record.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest central-file history and authored the adjacent metadata-only audit direction.
